evidence.notes: Local queueable jobs accept AsyncOptions minimum delay metadata and expose it during queueable execution.
Local AsyncOptions accepts minimum queueable delay metadata for deterministic queueable execution.
Local queueable execution reports the delay metadata carried by System.enqueueJob.

name: async-options-delay-local-evidence
salesforceExclusionReason: API 67 clean-org rejects the exercised AsyncOptions delay setter; retained as local evidence and excluded from hosted parity.

source.content: public class DelayFixture { public static Integer seenDelay; public class QueueWorker implements Queueable { public void execute(QueueableContext context) { seenDelay = System.AsyncInfo.getMinimumQueueableDelayInMinutes(); } } }

@isTest private class DelayFixtureTest { @isTest static void carriesDelayIntoQueueable() { AsyncOptions opts = new AsyncOptions(); opts.setMinimumQueueableDelayInMinutes(7); Test.startTest(); System.enqueueJob(new DelayFixture.QueueWorker(), opts); Test.stopTest(); System.assertEquals(7, DelayFixture.seenDelay); } }
